Job Summary
Aretum is seeking a Databricks Implementation Engineer to support the immediate development and maintenance of enterprise-scale data pipelines and cloud data solutions in AWS GovCloud for Department of War (DoW) data modernization initiatives. You will develop ETL/ELT pipelines, support data architecture, and enable automation and performance optimization. Your work will give DoW leadership real-time analytics and data-driven decision support for priority initiatives, such as childcare forecasting, Military OneSource analytics, and readiness dashboards, for users with varying levels of technical proficiency.

• Implement modern data architecture patterns, including lakehouse approaches.

• Support data transformation roadmaps and update technical documentation.

• Partner with cross-functional teams and program offices to understand data requirements and enable data. governance.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field; or comparable work experience.
